scenarios.mech: Recommend a dedicated authorisation under the Unified Licence, replacing fragmented annual service permissions with a longer service-licensing framework.
Recommend a standalone aviation data service licence with longer validity and tailored obligations.
Retain the existing permission mechanism while simplifying location-specific renewal requirements instead of adding service licensing.

forecasts.notes: More than seven months have elapsed since consultation launch. Recommendations can proceed faster than binding implementation, but the consultation leaves the fundamental licensing choice open. Content categories are approximate because E1 presents alternatives.

scenarios.mech: Adopt the proposed remuneration ceiling, variable-pay structure, deferral and clawback safeguards with limited clarification.
Retain risk alignment and clawbacks while raising compensation limits or relaxing variable-pay and deferral requirements.
Preserve quantitative pay rules while allowing selected exemptions and strengthening implementation or recovery provisions.

forecasts.notes: The detailed replacement framework supports eventual adoption. Fifteen months since the draft allows substantial processing time but does not establish publication readiness. Compensation restrictions create ordinary pressure for flexibility and transition relief.
missing: Revisions to pay and tenure provisions

scenarios.mech: Finalize a common content and format framework emphasizing clear, concise instructions for products with complicated patient-use procedures.
Preserve the clarity objectives while allowing more variation in presentation across drug, biological and combination products.
Retain the framework while adding specificity to how applicants organize and explain patient-use steps.

forecasts.notes: FDA guidance often remains draft for several years. The nearly three-year interval permits finalization but supplies little timing precision. The bounded labeling objective favors continuity in content conditional on publication.

scenarios.mech: Authorize lending and borrowing of government securities through a framework supplementing special repos and enabling deployment of idle holdings.
Adopt the lending framework with phased implementation or initially narrower participation to manage operational complexity.
Permit securities lending while adding transaction controls or reporting obligations that temper the participation objective.

forecasts.notes: An explicit policy commitment followed promptly by draft directions supports adoption. More than eight months since the comment deadline permits substantial processing, although market infrastructure coordination can extend implementation work.

scenarios.mech: Require aggregation services to present loan offers transparently so borrowers can compare available lenders and make informed choices.
Retain transparency requirements while allowing more implementation flexibility or a longer transition for lending service providers.
Supplement disclosure requirements with additional safeguards governing how aggregated offers are presented to borrowers.

forecasts.notes: The accepted recommendation, policy announcement and subsequent draft indicate sustained commitment. Six months since comments closed supports a meaningful six-month adoption probability, with technical implementation and consultation revisions remaining ordinary sources of delay.

scenarios.s: New review category and revised frequency
scenarios.mech: Add the proposed medical diary category, revise assignment criteria and change review frequency for permanent impairments.
Adopt selected diary changes while limiting affected cases or easing the proposed review schedule.
Retain the new category while phasing implementation and modifying assignment or notice requirements.

forecasts.notes: The final-stage agenda and October target raise near-term prospects. Agenda dates frequently slip, and economically significant eligibility-review changes require substantial analysis and implementation planning. Prior timetable revisions support a sizeable delay probability.
missing: Operational capacity and revised impact analysis

scenarios.mech: Allow reclassification at any time when legally and practicably enforceable emission limits keep sources below major-source thresholds.
Retain reclassification eligibility and thresholds while easing proposed notification or enforceability implementation requirements.
Permit reclassification while strengthening documentation, monitoring or compliance safeguards for sources leaving major-source status.

forecasts.notes: Completed OIRA review of the final rule is a strong publication signal. A month has elapsed since clearance, supporting high near-term probability despite earlier agenda slippage. Clearance with changes leaves some content uncertainty.
missing: Changes to enforceability and notification provisions

scenarios.mech: Finalize substantially the reviewed staff amendments already refined through internal consultation.
Adopt the amendments with narrower application or transitional accommodations responding to stakeholder comments.

forecasts.notes: Internal consultation and a reviewed exposure draft suggest maturity; comments closed more than three months ago. Administrative amendments commonly proceed without another broad consultation. Missing Annexure A prevents a meaningful forecast of specific substantive provisions.

scenarios.mech: Finalize recommendations for locally applied corticosteroid products treating short-term symptoms of internal or external hemorrhoids.
Retain the stated product and treatment scope while modifying development recommendations following discussions with sponsors, academics and the public.

forecasts.notes: The draft is approximately one year old and explicitly frames continued discussion. FDA guidance finalization commonly takes multiple years. The notice provides too little substantive detail to forecast particular development requirements confidently.

scenarios.mech: Adopt the proposed reductions in overall offer duration and early disclosure and filing deadlines.
Shorten both processes while retaining more time for selected intermediary or regulatory steps.
Adopt the core reforms and shorten additional steps while allowing flexibility elsewhere.

forecasts.notes: PMAC agreement and AIBI support favor adoption of a bounded procedural reform. Nearly eight months allows processing time. Counting an adopting board announcement as decisive raises the probability relative to requiring completed notification.
